summary_1line: At dusk Arjuna and Krishna carve through armies toward Jayadratha; Arjuna slays Vinda and Anuvinda, then dismounts to hold off troops while Krishna tends the exhausted horses.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna drives Arjuna’s chariot at impossible speed through a sea of warriors, wheels rolling over broken chariots and fallen elephants as arrows blaze ahead.
Arjuna stands on the ground alone with the Gandiva bow, surrounded by a ring of chariots raining arrows like dark clouds around the sun.
The mace‑wielding Anuvinda rushes forward and strikes Krishna on the forehead while Arjuna releases arrows that sever his limbs mid‑charge.
